messages:
maya: Heads-up — need to push an urgent hotfix to prod for a model-routing fallback bug. This is causing ~10% error rate for some hosted customers. I don't have prod-deploy role. Requesting JIT and MFA so I can run the fix during the current change window. @oncall please ack.

deploy-bot: To deploy to prod you must have the 'prod-deployer' role and an active MFA session. Request JIT access by running: `/request_jit --user maya --role prod-deployer --duration 1h`

maya: running `/request_jit --user maya --role prod-deployer --duration 1h` now (request 12345)

deploy-bot: JIT request #12345 created. Pending approvals: 2 approvers with 'release-signer' role required. Audit note required in thread.

liam: I can approve. @sara can you take a look from security side? Also, let's pin the image to a hotfix tag (example: v2026.03.19-hotfix1) rather than a floating latest.

sara: security: ok to approve JIT provided we have a short justification in the audit log and the change is scoped. Also confirm rollback target.

maya: justification: urgent routing key fallback causing incorrect model selection under load; impacts hosted inference for certain customers. Rollback not ideal because the fix is a small key check and safe, but rollback plan: revert routing image to v2026.03.18-stable if issues.

andre: +1 from release-signer. Approving request 12345 now.

deploy-bot: JIT request #12345 approved by liam, andre. Role 'prod-deployer' granted to maya until 2026-03-19T15:45Z. MFA required for deploy commands. Audit entry created: "routing fallback hotfix — JIT 12345"

maya: starting canary: `/deploy --service routing --image redwood/routing:v2026.03.19-hotfix1 --canary 5% --notes "routing fallback fix"`

deploy-bot: Canary started (canary_id=6789). Logs streaming: `INFO: routing key fallback check applied; latency delta +2ms`

oncall: monitoring dashboards: canary latency stable, errors dropped to baseline. No customer-facing alerts yet.

sara: good. Remember to add a one-line release note and tag the commit. Also create a tiny rollback playbook in the ticket in case we need a fast revert.

maya: release note draft: "Fix: routing fallback that could choose incorrect model under specific load patterns (v2026.03.19-hotfix1)." Will push to releases page after prod success.

liam: rollback plan if needed: trigger `/rollback --service routing --image redwood/routing:v2026.03.18-stable --reason "hotfix regression"` and notify customers via status page. Keep the canary for at least 10m and check p50/p95.

deploy-bot: Canary healthy at 10m. Promotion available: `/promote --canary 6789`

maya: promoting now — `/promote --canary 6789`

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. v2026.03.19-hotfix1 deployed to prod across routing service. Audit: JIT 12345, approved by liam, andre; deploy initiated by maya; MFA verified.

sara: noted in audit logs. Closing JIT session and recording justification. Please add latency/cost deltas to the release note.

andre: nice work. Please file a short post-deploy note in #eng-releases with any anomalies. :thumbsup:

maya: will do — filing post-deploy note and updating release notes now. thanks everyone :tada:
